name: harness-event-permission-requested
notes: Sources/PhoneDSHAgentCore/AgentHarness.swift:397 and 264-295 (risk is read_only, side_effect or ui; expires_at is optional). DSH maps an approval/request waterfall into a best-effort event with no seq and the DSH event id as request_id (DSHRemoteHarness.swift:397-409), so it is never replayed after a resume; the answer travels back as permission_response.
